headline: 5 Things India Is Now Proactively Banning To Keep Donald Trump In A Good Mood
body:
1. All spicy street-side Samosas that contain more than 15% potato filling, to prevent any 'unauthorized domestic inflation' accusations.

2. The use of the color orange in national cricket team jerseys, which will now be replaced with a muted 'neutral-beige' to avoid any mistaken political branding.

3. Any traffic jam lasting longer than six minutes, as the Ministry of Foreign Affairs now worries the U.S. might view gridlock as a sign of 'unregulated infrastructure enthusiasm.'

4. The consumption of non-American style coffee, with all local 'Filter Kaapi' outlets now required to serve lukewarm liquid that vaguely resembles puddle water.

5. Public displays of nostalgia regarding the 1990s, to ensure India is perceived as a strictly 'future-focused' nation that never remembers a time before bilateral trade agreements.
caption: From potato-less samosas to the total ban on nostalgia, here is how we're making sure the US remains our bestie. Tag a friend who would be devastated by the loss of potato-heavy snacks. #IndUS #TradeTalks #SamosaDiplomacy (satire)
igHook: Which of these preemptive bans would hurt your daily routine the most?
